findings.summary: The new _pooled_speed docstring says 'every language run of a model', and commit 6df2e46 says 'per-model'. The grouping key is a run name, not a model.
findings.evidence: group_by_model (results_store.py:371-376) keys on result.metadata.name, and RunMetadata.name returns run_id or model_id (records.py:115-117). A group is therefore one run identity, which may be narrower than a whole model. Behaviour is unchanged, so this is wording only. The fix is a docstring wording change, for example 'every language run sharing one run name'. Amending the commit message changes the SHA, so decide before the reconciled SHA is locked.
